svg.text: WHY THE BLOCK IS A THEOREM · TWO WORLDS, ONE RECORD
Both worlds carry B′ and leave one record, while the value holds on the
first and fails on the second. A route that reads only what the two
worlds share answers both alike, so it decides neither: the demand for
a zero-bit proof asks for a term of a type the kernel proves empty.
